description: Drafts the brief the company's management will read: your headline, what you heard from them, the facts you choose (recorded ones only, each shown with its source) and catalog options, with your own price per option if you want one in the brief. Saved on this computer for you to review. Nothing is sent and nothing reaches Trood. Show the person the brief and let them change it before they publish it.

factIds.description: Ids of recorded facts to show

headline.description: One line in their terms, for example "Answering every guest in minutes at Sample Retreat"

heard.description: What their team told you, written to them ('Your front desk answers in shifts...')

options.description: Options from one industry in get_catalog

amount.description: Price for this option, set by the person

preparedBy.description: Your name or company, shown as "Prepared by"

name: draft_offer
title: Draft an offer
